$description: Scaalus business and messaging source of truth. Who Scaalus serves, what it delivers, and how to talk about it. Copy is always written fresh — this file gives the facts, the results and the rules, not finished posts.

company.name: Scaalus
company.one-liner: A done-for-you growth system that gets high-ticket home service businesses found, answers and follows up every lead, and turns them into booked jobs — while the owner stays on the job.
company.promise: A calendar full of booked jobs. Not a phone full of missed calls.
company.positioning: Scaalus is its own complete system for home service owners: one setup that brings customers in, catches every lead and books the job. It is never presented as a reseller, a white-label product or a bundle of other companies' tools.

audience.who: US home service business owners whose jobs are high-ticket — where losing a single customer costs them thousands.
audience.why-it-matters: One missed call or one slow reply can mean a lost roof replacement, HVAC install or remodel — often worth thousands. These owners are on job sites, not at a desk, so leads slip through every day.
pains: Missing calls while on a roof, in an attic or driving between jobs
Leads going cold because nobody followed up fast enough
Competitors answering first and taking the job
Hard to find on Google when homeowners search for a local pro
No time for marketing, websites or reviews
Quiet weeks with gaps in the calendar
Past customers never hearing from them again
audience.they-understand: Jobs, calls, customers, homeowners, the calendar, reviews, Google, revenue, their crew, their time.
audience.they-do-not-care-about: Software names, CRMs, automations, workflows, integrations, AI models or any technical how-it-works.

offer.$description: Every Scaalus service and the result a post should say instead. Posts lead with the result; the service is internal language.

services.service: A website built to book jobs and rank locally
services.result: A website that turns visitors into booked jobs — day and night.
examples: Your website should book jobs, not just look nice.
Homeowners land on your site and book on the spot.

services.service: Google Business Profile optimisation and local SEO
services.result: Show up first when homeowners search for your service nearby.
examples: Be the first roofer they see on Google.
More calls from Google — without paying for every click.

services.service: Automatic text back on missed calls
services.result: Every missed call gets a text back in seconds, so the job stays yours.
examples: Missed a call on the roof? They already got a text from you.
Every missed call is a job for your competitor — unless you answer it first.

services.service: AI calling agent that answers and qualifies calls
services.result: Every call answered, 24/7 — even when you're on a job site.
examples: You're on a roof. Your phone still gets answered.
No more voicemail. Every caller gets an answer and a booking.

services.service: AI chatbot on the website and social messages
services.result: Questions answered and appointments booked, even at 2 a.m.
Every lead followed up until they book — no lead goes cold.
examples: Most jobs are lost to slow follow-up. Yours won't be.

services.result: Jobs land straight in your calendar — no phone tag.

services.service: A dedicated app for the owner
services.result: Every lead, call and message in one place on your phone.
examples: Your whole pipeline in your pocket.

services.result: Past customers come back for their next job.
examples: Your best next job is a customer you already have.

services.result: More 5-star reviews, on autopilot — and more trust before the first call.
examples: Every finished job asks for a 5-star review.

outcomes: A full calendar, even in slow weeks
Never losing a job to a missed call
Revenue protected on every high-ticket lead

usage.trial-and-no-contract: Fine to use often: in calls to action, captions and the last carousel slide ("Start your 14-day free trial", "No contract. Cancel anytime.").
usage.price: Use sparingly. Show $297/month only where price is the point — an offer or pricing post, an ad that needs it, or when the user asks. Never make it the default headline or put it on every post; lead with the result instead.
usage.never: Never invent discounts, promo prices, setup fees or different trial lengths.

messaging-rules.rule: Lead with the result, not the service.
messaging-rules.why: Owners scroll past features they don't understand. They stop for results they want: booked jobs, a full calendar, no missed calls.

messaging-rules.rule: Translate every service into an owner outcome using offer.services[].result.
messaging-rules.why: 'SMS automation' means nothing to a roofer; 'every lead followed up until they book' does.

messaging-rules.rule: Speak the owner's language: jobs, calls, customers, calendar, reviews, Google, crew.
messaging-rules.why: No tech jargon — talk like a business owner, not a software company.

messaging-rules.rule: Never name any software, platform, CRM or vendor behind Scaalus, and never describe Scaalus as white-label, resold or built on another product.
messaging-rules.why: Scaalus is always presented as its own system.

messaging-rules.rule: Make the cost of a lost job felt.
messaging-rules.why: The audience sells high-ticket work; one missed call can be a lost job worth thousands. Pain → result is the core story.

messaging-rules.rule: One message per post, headline under 10 words when possible.
messaging-rules.why: Owners read posts in seconds between jobs.

messaging-rules.rule: Keep the price in the background. Mention the 14-day free trial and no contract freely; show $297/month only on offer or pricing posts.
messaging-rules.why: The result sells the call; the price is a detail for owners who are already interested.

messaging-rules.rule: Never invent numbers, stats, testimonials or client names. Use real figures only, or a clear placeholder like [X jobs].
messaging-rules.why: Made-up proof breaks trust and can break advertising rules.

messaging-rules.rule: Every post ends on scaalus.com or a clear next step (book a demo, start a trial).
messaging-rules.why: Each post should move the owner one step closer to a call.

voice.tone: Simple, clear, confident. Results-first. Talks like a business owner, not a tech company.
